model: Sequential traversal with named relation/program and event-history projection; hybrid is intentionally permitted.

types.Endpoint: opaque constant identity A or B
types.Traveller: p with actual position and goal
types.RelationPath: nonempty ordered edges with adjacent matching endpoints
types.NamedRelation: bound relation path plus exact defining source ID
types.Event: fresh ID with source,target,path/edge and triggering source ID
types.Run: ordered event IDs bounded by explicit MARK_RUN and SEAL_RUN
types.Projection: first source to final target, retaining source history provenance
types.BooleanRecord: typed assertion with exact compared operands
types.Setup: named inputs, permission and goal checks; hypothetical premises distinguished from event history
types.Report: finite collection of consumed records and computed comparisons

rules.definition: Introduce opaque endpoint A; node focus A.
Introduce opaque endpoint B; node focus B.
Require A,B; set current relation to edge E=A->B; repeated use co-refers exact same E.
Store current relation as R; no traversal.
Mark named R permitted; no traversal.
Derive inverse(R) and store S.
Declare named R and S permitted.
Introduce traveller p at R.target B; initial position is explicit paid input, not an observed fact.
Set p.goal=R.source A.
Set current relation=S.
Compare p.position with current relation.source and permitted status; produce boolean.
Compare current relation.target with p.goal; produce boolean.
Store setup predicates with actual inputs; current relation remains unchanged.
Set current relation to named R.
Store current relation as W.
Inverse current relation; reverse ordered path order and inverse every edge.
Require current relation enabled; execute its ordered edges as fresh events, update p.position; current relation unchanged.
Set current relation to named W.
Store current relation as L, replacing previous L explicitly.
Build current relation followed by its converse; produce a named path expression, no event.
Consume current accumulated event history since INTRO_TRAVELLER; report whether first source equals last target.
Perform explicit relocation of existing traveller from actual position to A as a fresh event; this is not a line reset or hidden premise.
Save current relation as comparison register D, replacing prior D explicitly.
Append current relation and source provenance to description-record list; no event.
Compare current relation with D extensionally; write true/false record with both operands.
Set current relation=converse(current); require enabled and execute it as fresh events.
Mark next event index as beginning of a run; no location reset.
Name current relation N, an unexecuted program; no event.
Execute enabled current relation as fresh event(s), then set current relation to its converse for next step.
Record actual p.position; no event.
Close run begun by MARK_RUN; bind ordered run events by exact event IDs.
Require closed run; name its endpoint projection T and set current relation to T; retains full event history distinct from projection.
Project full ordered executed history to endpoint relation H; retain original events, no traversal.
Consume named T and H plus stored setup/description/comparison records; report their endpoint relations, equality/non-equality and return checks.
Only two exact listed compounds: olol executes ol then ol; qolshey executes qol then shey. Every part has its ordinary effective behavior. No general concatenation/parser/license.

policies.repeats: One fixed whole rule for every exact repeat; fresh events from repeat execution differ only by input state and identity. No occurrence-fitted values.
policies.scope: One paragraph/global register scope; line ends have no semantic reset/closure. Only explicit constructor words modify state.
policies.reference: R,S,W,L,D,N,T,H are named typed registers; use before definition blocks. Current relation and existing traveller are explicitly paid ambient operands for rules named above.
policies.unknown: No unknown noun/default/repair/alias; unavailable word, operand or type is first barrier. Complete all59 rows even if blocked.
policies.execution: Path source must equal p.position; explicit relocation is an actual paid event. Each execution emits fresh identities. No implicit initial stock/sole participant availability.
policies.semantics: Opaque journey endpoints/traveller and operation names are C0 guesses; no old recipe/prepare/pour meanings or confirmed anchors inherited.
policies.formal_composition: The two hypothesized exact compound cuts are paid semantic choices, not learned BPE grammar evidence; keep whole residuals for all other exact words. No universal qo/r/l/dy/aiin semantics.
policies.alternates: Preserve all ZL59/RF58 rows, raw uncertainty, native separators and flags; no joining o/l or entity normalization. This dictionary admits only exact listed forms; report actual alternative barriers, no independent witnesses.

paid_ambient_input_policies: Current relation is explicit ambient operand for applicable relation/execution/record operators.
Existing traveller p is explicit ambient execution subject after otain introduces p at named R.target.
EXECUTE_ALTERNATE switches relation only after completed actual execution.
RETURN_CHECK/PROJECT_TOTAL consume history beginning at explicit traveller introduction.
MARK_RUN/SEAL_RUN identify a subhistory by explicit marker positions, not by fixed line or fixed number of events.
Only literal A,B and actor p introduced by explicit whole words; no unnamed participant.

costs_at_freeze.whole_residual_policy: 37 paid exact atomic meanings; do not call them composition-derived.

prospective_internal_consequence: Named relation E=A->B is distinct from a B-start executed return history. Closed subrun projects A->B; final total history is compared with that subrun projection, without storing a per-line result. Internal coherence is not semantic selection.
extension_policy: No constructor/dictionary edits after this freeze. If the finite declared account cannot finish, retain first construction barrier rather than repair this file.
